title: Los verbos de cambio hacerse y volverse
goal: Deploy 'hacerse' for voluntary professional/ideological changes and 'volverse' for involuntary character shifts.
grammar: verbos de cambio hacerse y volverse: voluntad frente a cambio involuntario de carácter

items: Select 'hacerse' for gradual or voluntary ideological and career developments.
Apply 'volverse' for permanent involuntary transformations in temperament.
Avoid using 'hacerse' with involuntary psychological disorders.
